_comment: Hero Surface input grouping map (PR 3 of the 2026-04-20 Hero Surface deep-review). Documents the canonical surface-vs-internal partition for SMC_Long_Dip_Dashboard.pine and SMC_Long_Dip_Mobile.pine. Consumed by pine_input_surface.py regroup as a re-entrant safety net: re-running it must be a no-op against the current files. Surface inputs stay visible in the first product group; every chart-link binding and internal override stays in its own group with display = display.none. Group VARIABLES are the partition; the group LABELS are customer-facing text and may be reworded freely (2026-08-12).
invariants: Every input in a Surface or Mobile Surface group is visible (no display.none).

Every input in any internal group (chart-link bindings, debug mirrors, manual overrides) has display = display.none. Until 2026-08-12 this list omitted g_bus_blockers and g_bus_preset, so two of the nine internal groups were never checked.
Hero state values are read exclusively from mp.HERO_* fields; surface code does not re-derive them.
